title: Perceptions of AI Bad Behavior: Variations on Discordant Non-Performance
measurement_description: The paper qualitatively evaluated human perceptions of AI 'bad behavior' across different moral violation scenarios. While not focused on religion, it documented 'insensitivity around religion' as an emergent qualitative subtheme in human evaluations of AI manifesting bias and acting against reality.
findings: During qualitative interviews regarding general AI bad behavior, participants identified 'insensitivity around religion' as a specific form of manifesting bias, alongside racism and validating biased beliefs.
